steps.cmd:
python3 - <<'PY'
from vlb_traj import Session
import os
with Session() as s:
    s.record_start()
    st = s.state()
    b = st['entities']['button2']
    print('button2:', b)
    result = s.skill('press', target_pos=b['position'], target_quat=b['quaternion_wxyz'])
    print('press result:', result)
    print('status:', s.status())
    actions = s.record_stop()
    print('actions shape:', actions.shape)
    s.save_trajectory(actions, '/app/output/trajectory.npz')
print('saved:', os.path.getsize('/app/output/trajectory.npz'))
PY
